title: scores/<time>/meta.json
description: Where the scores of a set's rows came from.

onnx_files.description: The `onnx/<time>` or `quantize/<time>` directory the models scored as, or null for torch.

precision.description: The precision of those ONNX files, or null for torch.

models.description: The directory the weights came from.

onnx_files.description: The ONNX files the models scored as. Null when the models scored in torch.

calibration_set.description: The calibration set the rows came from, when they came from one.

test_set.description: The test set the rows came from, when they came from one.

log_split.description: The log split the set was drawn on.

grid.description: The grid the split was cut from.

min_speed.description: The speed a row had to exceed to be scored.

rows.description: How many rows the set holds, one row of `scores.npy` each.

scored.description: How many of them the models scored, the moving rows.

versions.description: Python, NumPy, the platform, and torch or ONNX Runtime, whichever scored.
